yd:
Prime Agent is a new type of AI agent. Regular agents pick from a fixed list of tools, like reading a document or writing code. Prime Agent has one single tool, and that tool builds any tool it needs. Think of a personal workshop that makes a hammer or a screwdriver depending on the task. It is the first agent built on RLM, and we don't know yet if it will beat regular agents.
